met-when.says: The hub and authority scores of a graph of cells are computed by the HITS iteration in exact arithmetic to a stated number of rounds, and equal a reference HITS implementation's scores on the same graph to its precision.

A route between two cells is chosen by those scores alone, reinforced along the edges that were used and decayed along those that were not, as a slime mold reinforces the tubes that carry flow; no other ranking takes part.
